programme.desc: The Queen of Female Kingdom falls in love with Monk Tang, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be killed. As the River Spirit appears, the kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: May We Chat
programme.desc: Dealing with the controversial issues of youth and sex, this film captures how three young women struggle to find a balance between reality and their ideals.

programme.title: American Dreams In China
programme.desc: Co-produced & directed by Peter Chan, starring Huang Xiao Ming, Deng Chao & Tong Da Wei, three undergraduates are brought together by a common ambition - to live the American dream.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Body and Soul
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns featuring three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist, and a chef.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programme.desc: Revisit the legend of Ma Yong Zhen, a boxer who only wanted to survive in Shanghai, but was swept into a battle against its largest triad on a quest for revenge.

programme.title: Ah Boys to Men 2
programme.desc: Ken and his band of brothers return to serve the nation again, with Ken determined to change & prove himself a better man. However, his mates feel otherwise, causing tension among them.

programme.title: Crypto Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market.

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer
programme.desc: When a flash of her groom's infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: Young And Dangerous : Reloaded
programme.desc: Based on a popular comic featuring the adventures of a young triad gang in Mongkok, this sharp remake features a new generation in a razor-edged thriller.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: After a security engineer unwittingly becomes involved in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2
programme.desc: Set as a prequel, when the sun was found to be dying, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home. To save the world, a group of young people decide to step forth.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Hao Ren inherits the skills of Locksmith Shan and befriends Detective Liu who often seeks his help. When Hao Ren unveils the mystery of Shan's wife's disappearance one day, strange events ensue.

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: Andy Lau & Huang Xiao Ming embark on a cross-border quest in the quest to protect an incredible new invention from an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: \"Rent-a-Family\" offers relatives for rent and in the process, the trio rendering such services discover the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired special agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the street is forcibly demolished by the local gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: A top-rated film based on a true case in Hong Kong, it tells of a young man who plots with his friend to murder & dismember his parents, resulting in a highly controversial court case.

programme.title: Ha Ha Ha Happy New Year!!
programme.desc: Business tycoon Duan accidentally loses his memory. As he is cared for by a temple owner, Duan discovers that he has been replaced by a doppelganger, prompting him to uncover a shocking hidden secret.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Headed by elite pilots, a special operations team is tasked to test new fighter jets. During test flights, the pilots face different difficulties and challenges, and try to push beyond their limits.

programme.title: Men Suddenly In Love
programme.desc: When five male ex-classmates reunite to throw their 80-year old biology teacher a birthday party, five hot models take the party to an unexpected level.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archaeologist uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream, so he leads his team to a fantastical adventure into the glacier to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Bored with their mundane country lifestyle, a retired superhero couple sets out to make a comeback at the upcoming Martial World Assembly.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: After his incarceration, a former boxer learns that his wife has passed away, leaving behind a sick daughter. To get her to undergo treatment, he agrees to step into the ring again.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead...

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal.

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu waits 10 years for her first love, who marries another. Losing faith, she meets a wedding planner and a wealthy man, both offering solace. Torn between them, who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: July and An Sheng's strong friendship is put to the test when they encounter a guy, Su Jia Ming, sparking a love triangle that alters both their destinies.

programme.title: WE 12
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: A pregnant woman gains the ability to see ghosts after her attempted suicide. She comes to suspect that it is related to the female ghost she witnessed jumping into the path of an oncoming train.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr. Lo's sons prank Kung on his birthday with a fake lottery win, sparking chaos that unexpectedly heals old wounds and brings the quirky family closer together.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Beggar Su and his brother train incessantly to defeat the brutally powerful thief called Centipede.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: A former Monkey Kung Fu master crippled by a ruthless villain is convinced by his young disciple to teach him monkey kung fu, so as to avenge his shame.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: Beloved heroine Cheng Pei-Pei again plays a swordswoman who teams with a swordsman named Drunken Cat to battle a corrupt Buddhist monk.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother’s death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei fall in love. Yet the film turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks and forcing a pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Danny Lee stars in this fascinating Sino-Vietnamese crime saga from actor-turned-director Wang Chung, as a misunderstood refugee being trailed by Ray Luis forthright cop.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel and she hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: A young woman sets out to reunite feuding brothers to take out a gang of killers who have murdered their father.

programme.title: Rivals Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Everyone wants to win the annual Lion Dance Trophy, including Wong Fei Hung. His jealous rivals, led by Master Shen, try to frame Wong by placing a decomposed corpse in his Po Chi Lam clinic.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: The 70s idol Hsing Hui and Yon Fan star in this horror movie. Young business man marries pretty, young bride, never knowing that she carries the spirit and everything starts there.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and become patriotic heroes accidentally. Assisted by a warlords daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Tiger And The Widow
programme.desc: In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Master Tie Qiao San is an honorable and respected kung fu master, one of the Ten Tigers of Kwantung. Hes also developed a bit of a taste for opium, though, and his habit is getting worse.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: This legendary tale of courage and heroism stars Ivy Ling Po as Mulan, the young woman who joined the army and became a true heroine of the Chinese people.

programme.title: Clans Of Intrigue
programme.desc: One day, when the heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, Gong from the Holy Water Palace accuses Chu of stealing the holy water and using it for various murders.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the enemies and save the Buddha statue.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate so obsessed with finding a hidden treasure that he not only jails and tortures his daughters lover, but buries his daughter alive as well! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret is revealed.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Legendary actress Lin Feng Jiao stars in this romantic comedy as an unlikely romance occurs between an entrepreneurs son and a kindergartens principals niece.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities
programme.desc: Amorous complications and modern morals are just the beginning in Macau, where a love quartet is the source for sexy merriment.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Wang Yu witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by Yuen Wahs vicious villain. Although he escapes, the killer saw the large eagle emblazoned on our heros chest.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, however, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf for winning the lantern contest. At the same time, Zhao plans for revenge.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: A heroic family is double crossed and massacred on the battle field with only two of the brothers surviving the slaughter. One of them escapes to a Shaolin temple and the vengeance puts him at odds with the monks.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: The Monkey King and his gang are confronted by the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her two sexy sisters, plus a cast of fanciful characters.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: The glorious Betty Loh Ti stars as a beauty who disguises herself as a boy in order to receive a forbidden education in this multi award-winning drama from director Li Han Hsiang.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: The lovely Michelle Mei Suet plays a spoiled girl Szu-szu who ignores her true love Yang Fan to go off in search of a swordsman Chin Ko she idolizes.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: City Of Desire
programme.desc: Sandra returns to Macau after having been in Canada for the last twenty years. Her father is ill and the business is being passed on to her, but she is taken aback to discover that the family business is prostitution.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archeologist noticed that the texture of the relics discovered during the excavation of a glacier closely resembled a jade pendant seen in one of his dreams.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: A young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, defense attorneys face each other as nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: This film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932.

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: A small cleaning company owner hits tough times during the pandemic. In need of an assistant, he hires a young single mother who unexpectedly helps him solve many difficulties at work.

programme.title: Acting Out Of Love
programme.desc: Wei Hung Jen is a struggling actor. Hui Hsin, the associate producer, must write a script for a love story so as to get a reference letter to study scriptwriting overseas. Later Jen falls for Hui.

programme.title: All U Need Is Love
programme.desc: Ten major film companies join forces on a comedy-drama film to raise funds and create jobs for industry workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. This film features an all-star ensemble cast starring for free, with the story revolving around a group of hotel guests placed under quarantine in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: A debt-ridden wedding planner inadvertently becomes a successful funeral planner, but he must convince a traditional Taoist priest of his legitimacy to continue operating in the field.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Chen and his partner Guan are legendary navigators, but in the process of helping a girl Xiao Yu, they must also face their own problems.

programme.title: Marrying Mr. Perfect
programme.desc: Winnie is dumped by her boyfriend in her late twenties and unknowingly meets Koo, a ruthless tycoon in business and a playboy. Koo temporarily switches identities with his driver for security reason and falls for Winnie as she is the first girl to love him for who he is. What will happen when Winnie know Koo’s real identity?

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee is the Production head of an advertising firm who tries to improve her teams performance by competing with Creative head Chan in the day and clubbing at Lan Kwai Fong for ideas at night.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack and Chuns boss is the mastermind of the attack. When Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight to prove his innocence in the cyber world.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Su-hyeon, a patient with terminal cancer, gets a wig as a present from her sister, Ji-hyeon. Strange things happen as Su-hyeon wears the wig and horror starts to sweep over Ji-hyeon as she watches her sister getting slowly possessed.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: About three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost, a boy commits suicide, and some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: Chi is a property agent who leads an aimless and unfulfilling life until he reunites with his P.E. teacher, Wong, from primary school. Despite his illness, Wong insists on keeping his promise of completing a 10K marathon to his late wife. Inspired by Wong, Chi brings himself to his feet and finds the courage to cheer himself on!

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: After an explosion kills Yin Ching, Lou feels drawn to Lam Yam, her lookalike. Both loved Lou, but had different backgrounds. Chings vengeful plan stemmed from Lou accidentally killing her mother years ago.

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: A gambling addict and her anti-gambling husband face relationship challenges when she must return to her old ways after criminals target her family.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence, landslides, and put a town nearby are at stake. Will the authority blow up the tunnel?

programme.title: Black Ransom
programme.desc: Mann is forced to return to his former glory when he is assigned to investigate a former police inspector suspected to be kidnapping mafia bosses and demanding ransoms in exchange for their lives.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: An urban sketcher suffering from ALS wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. Then, he asks his old classmate to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day.

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: One day, Li accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince! While he aims to secure a high ranking position in the palace, the prince wants freedom, so they decide to switch identities.

programme.title: The Battle At Lake Changjin
programme.desc: Set in the winter of 1950, a pivotal battle begins at the freezing Lake Changjin region. Facing extreme cold, hunger and weaker weapons, the Chinese troops nonetheless forge ahead.

programme.title: Stretching The Limits
programme.desc: Join us for Stretching the Limits series to find out more stories about the lives of the young Chinese generation on CGTN Documentary.

programme.title: Mega Equipment,
programme.desc: This is a series about the marvels of Chinese engineering - the forces that are powering the world’s largest manufacturing nation, the genius behind its mania for cutting-edge infrastructure development. In the first episode we look at the world’s biggest scooping bucket excavator as it harvests coal at Inner Mongolia’s Haerwusu Mine. Then we go underground to see a shield-tunneling machine, which can bore subway tunnels through any kind of rock. Lastly, we take a ride on the world’s biggest vertical hoist shiplift, which can carry 3,000-ton vessels over the Three Gorges Dam in Hubei province.

programme.title: The Power Of Science,
programme.desc: A science documentary that discusses the status quo of energy and climate crises and how the development of human civilization is intertwined with nature.

programme.title: Mega Equipment,
programme.desc: China’s energy resources tend to be concentrated in the far west, but energy is most intensively consumed in the booming cities of the east coast. To bridge this gap, China has built many mega projects, like the 4,200-km-long natural gas transmission network and the three West-East Ultra-high voltage transmission lines in the nation’s electrical grid. The constructions of all these projects call for the most advanced technical equipment - so-called ‘mega-equipment’. See the role that meg-equipment is playing in the lights on in China, and how it is opening a new chapter in the history of China’s rise as a major manufacturing power.

programme.title: WCCB: Huck Vs Garay
programme.desc: With the WBO Cruiserweight World Championship on the line, titleholder Marco Huck (33-1) defends against veteran contender Hugo Garay (34-6) at the Olympia Eissportzentrum in Munich, Germany. Huck, fighting in his adoptive home country, was making the 7th consecutive defense of his championship. Garay, of Argentina, recently held the WBA Light Heavyweight World Title and claimed a victory over top German fighter Juergen Braehmer, and is now looking to move up in weight and claim title gold at Cruiserweight. Dont miss Huck-Garay, on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The films story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the groups leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.
